dialog.title: Remove {{name}}?
dialog.bodyServices: Bayplan removes the stack's services, its own networks, and its own secrets and configs. External networks, secrets, configs and volumes are never touched.
dialog.bodyContainers: Bayplan removes the stack's containers, its own networks, and its own secrets and configs. External networks, secrets, configs and volumes are never touched.
dialog.loadFailed: Couldn't read what {{name}} owns. Check the connection and try again.
dialog.failed: Couldn't remove {{name}}: {{reason}} What was already removed stays removed. Remove the rest from this page.

refusal.operation_locked: Another stack operation is running on this environment. Try again when it finishes.
refusal.confirm_mismatch: The name you typed doesn't match.
refusal.volume_not_owned: One of the volumes isn't this stack's, so nothing was removed.

progress.title: Removing {{name}}
progress.description: Closing this window doesn't stop the removal. It carries on, and you'll see a message when it ends.
progress.doneKept: Removed {{name}}. Its definition is kept, so you can deploy it again.
progress.failed: Couldn't remove {{name}}: {{reason}} What was already removed stays removed. Remove the rest from this page.
progress.failedNoReason: Couldn't remove {{name}}. What was already removed stays removed. Remove the rest from this page.
progress.gone: This removal is no longer listed. Open the stack to see what is left.

toast.failed: Couldn't remove {{name}}: {{reason}} What was already removed stays removed. Remove the rest from this page.
toast.failedNoReason: Couldn't remove {{name}}. What was already removed stays removed. Remove the rest from this page.

volumes.heading: Volumes
volumes.helper: Volumes hold your data. Tick only the ones you're sure you don't need. Unticked volumes stay on the host.
volumes.empty: This stack has no volumes of its own.
volumes.label: Remove volume {{volume}}
volumes.usedOutside_one: {{count, number}} container outside this stack uses its volume {{volume}}. Removing the volume will fail while it runs.
volumes.usedOutside_other: {{count, number}} containers outside this stack use its volume {{volume}}. Removing the volume will fail while they run.
volumes.notReporting_one: {{nodes}} didn't answer, so its volumes aren't listed.
volumes.notReporting_other: {{nodes}} didn't answer, so their volumes aren't listed.

keep.label: Keep the definition
keep.helper: Keeps the compose file, files and variables so you can deploy it again. The stack shows as Not deployed.

stackRemove.draft: This stack has a saved draft. Removing the stack deletes it too.
